relationship: Constructing a topology and sending a packet connects physical links to connectivity and packet journey outcomes.

learnerLoop.action: Move nodes, add or remove cables, check the topology and send a packet.
learnerLoop.modelChange: The network graph and selectable packet path change.
learnerLoop.evidence: The canvas, feedback and journey text show whether the topology and transfer work.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Rewire the graph or choose another source and destination.

invariants: Topology checks and packet journeys use the current set of nodes and links.
Each visible cable represents a connection in the graph.
safeAdaptations: Change topology challenges, node labels or prompts while retaining editable graph construction and packet testing.
nonGoals: Providing a production network simulator or configuration tool.
